name: Mont Belvieu NGL complex, Texas (Energy Transfer and others)
description: world's largest NGL storage and fractionation hub: Energy Transfer facilities alone hold over 46 million barrels of storage and fractionate over 900,000 bpd; US NGL hub since the 1960s

sources.note: Energy Transfer Mont Belvieu facilities fact sheet, 29 Mar 2019 (46+ M bbl storage, >900 kbpd fractionation); OGJ: the Mont Belvieu NGL storage system is the largest in the world; read 2026-10-28
